name: pods-control
title: Pods Control
description: Control AirPods and Beats listening modes and Conversation Awareness, and show the confirmed mode in command subtitles.
author: raulg

commands.name: set-noise-cancellation
commands.title: Set to Noise Cancellation
commands.description: Set the connected AirPods or Beats to Noise Cancellation (ANC) listening mode.

commands.name: set-transparency
commands.title: Set to Transparency
commands.description: Set the connected AirPods or Beats to Transparency listening mode.

commands.name: set-adaptive
commands.title: Set to Adaptive
commands.description: Set the connected AirPods or Beats to Adaptive listening mode when the device supports it.

commands.name: set-off
commands.title: Set to Off
commands.description: Set the connected AirPods or Beats to the Off listening mode (no Noise Cancellation or Transparency).

commands.name: cycle-listening-mode
commands.title: Cycle Listening Mode
commands.description: Cycle through your preferred listening modes. The current mode is read from the connected AirPods or Beats before cycling, and unsupported modes are skipped.

preferences.name: cycleAnc
preferences.title: Modes to Cycle Through
preferences.label: Noise Cancellation
preferences.description: Include Noise Cancellation when cycling listening modes.

preferences.name: cycleTransparency
preferences.label: Transparency
preferences.description: Include Transparency when cycling listening modes.

preferences.name: cycleAdaptive
preferences.label: Adaptive
preferences.description: Include Adaptive when cycling listening modes. Skipped automatically if the connected device does not support it.

preferences.name: cycleOff
preferences.label: Off
preferences.description: Include Off when cycling listening modes.

commands.name: toggle-conversation-awareness
commands.title: Toggle Conversation Awareness
commands.description: Toggle Conversation Awareness on or off. Requires AirPods or Beats that support Conversation Awareness.

commands.name: pods-status
commands.title: Pods Status
commands.description: Read the combined status, Listening Mode, and Conversation Awareness subtitles now and about once a minute while Background Refresh is active. If deactivated, the last confirmed values remain visible until another status or control command.

commands.name: manage-cli
commands.title: Manage CLI
commands.description: Install, update, or fix the pods-control CLI used by this extension.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: CLI Path
preferences.description: Full path to the CLI binary. Leave empty to let Raycast find it automatically.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
